description: Angels (Guardian Spirits) are companion units that provide passive stat bonuses, battle skills, and development effects. They are organized into an array formation with typed slots, can be star-upgraded, and summoned via a gacha draw system.

ConfigAngel.description: Base angel definitions: identity, quality tier, type class, and visual assets.

type.description: Angel type class; maps to Angel_array slot filtering

image3.description: Icon asset ID (used in skill display)

ConfigAngel_star.description: Per-star-level data for each angel. Controls stat bonuses, battle skills unlocked at each star, develop effects, and upgrade costs.

frame.description: UI frame asset for this star level

attr.description: Stat bonuses granted at this star [[attrId, value], ...]

battle_skill1.description: Skill slot 1 data [[skillId, skillLevel], ...]; references ConfigSkill_level

battle_skill1_cost.description: Energy cost to cast skill 1 in battle

battle_skill2_cost.description: Energy cost to cast skill 2 in battle

develop_cost.description: Energy cost for the development slot in formation

power.description: Combat power contribution at this star level

ConfigAngel_skill.description: Angel-specific skill definitions. Slot 2 skills are looked up here; slot 1 skills use the standard ConfigSkill/ConfigSkill_level system.

skill_effect.description: Skill effect IDs triggered by this skill

ConfigAngel_develop.description: Development effect macro definitions. Maps IDs to server-side macro types.

ConfigAngel_array.description: Angel formation layout. Defines which angel types can be placed in which slots.

pos_type.description: Angel type allowed in this slot

normal.description: Normal pool ID for non-pity pulls

ConfigAngel_draw_time_limit.description: Limited-time angel gacha banner definitions with rate-up mechanics.

act_type.description: Activity type this banner belongs to

is_up.description: Whether this banner has rate-up active (0/1)

ConfigAngel_draw_package.description: Angel draw milestone/package rewards granted after N pulls.

premise.description: Pull count threshold to unlock this reward

formation.description: Angels are placed into a formation (Angel_array) with typed slots. Each formation type has multiple positions, and each position only accepts a specific angel type.

slots.main_slots: Positions 1-3 are main formation slots displayed in battle UI
slots.develop_slots: Positions 1-4 are development/support slots providing passive bonuses

star_upgrade.description: Each angel can be upgraded through star levels. Higher stars unlock better stats, stronger skills, and development effects.

skill_slots.slot1: Battle skill 1 -- references ConfigSkill + ConfigSkill_level; type indicates active/passive/aura. Cost deducted from shared energy pool.
skill_slots.slot2: Battle skill 2 -- references ConfigAngel_skill; a simpler skill with its own cost.

star_upgrade.stat_bonuses: The 'attr' field at each star provides attribute bonuses (e.g. [[attrId, value]]) applied to the player's combat stats.

battle_integration.description: In battle, main-slot angels contribute their battle_skill1 and battle_skill2. Skill 1 may be a standard battle skill looked up via ConfigSkill_level (with skillCoefficient for damage scaling). Skill 2 is an angel-specific skill from ConfigAngel_skill with its own skill_effect chain.
battle_integration.setSkillEffect_code: t.setSkillEffect = function(t, e) { var i = configAngel_skill.getDataByKey(e); null != i && (t.skillEffectList.push(i.skill_effect), t.skillDamList.push(i.skillPar)) }
battle_integration.energy_system: All angel skills share a single energy pool. Each skill has a cost (battle_skill1_cost, battle_skill2_cost). The total formation cost is displayed in the UI.
battle_integration.develop_passive: Development slot angels apply their develop_effect as a passive bonus during battle (e.g. stat multipliers, damage bonuses).

passive_skill_integration.description: Angel passive skills are loaded during battle setup via setPlayerPassiveSkill (line 187523). For each passive_skill entry, the system checks chapter_type compatibility, then adds the skill to the battle unit. If the angel enhances a specific skill (matching l[0]), it pushes additional skillEffect2 and skillDam entries plus up to 2 extra angel skill effects.
passive_skill_integration.chapter_type_filtering: checkPvpChapterTypeOk (line 187535) filters skills by chapter type. if_chapter_type=0 means inclusion mode (only listed chapters), non-zero means exclusion mode (all except listed).

gacha_system.description: Angels are obtained through a draw/gacha system with permanent banners (ConfigAngel_draw) and limited-time banners (ConfigAngel_draw_time_limit).
gacha_system.pity_system: The 'must' field defines guaranteed pull thresholds. After N pulls without a high-quality result, a guaranteed drop occurs.
gacha_system.rate_up: Limited banners can have rate-up (is_up=1) with prob_up overriding base probabilities for featured angels.
gacha_system.milestone_rewards: ConfigAngel_draw_package provides bonus rewards at pull count thresholds (premise field).

relatedSystems: ConfigSkill / ConfigSkill_level -- Skill 1 references the standard skill system
ConfigBuff -- Angel skills may apply buffs
ConfigSkilleffcet -- Angel skill effects chain through the standard effect system
